text:
alex: Quick heads-up — we need to lock a design-handoff review for the Configurable Routing API + SDK + Console UX before the sprint cut. Pre-read is up: https://drive.redwood.ai/pre-reads/config-routing-handoff (rough draft) :eyes:

maria: Thanks. rough agenda? reviewers?

alex: Agenda draft: 1) API contract & breaking changes 2) SDK ergonomics + auth flow 3) Console UX for routing policies 4) rollout & canary plan 5) docs + migration notes

kevin: I can cover SDK ergonomics. prefer a morning slot.

lina: Security & privacy should be in the agenda — add threat model + data residency checks.

alex: good call — adding security gating. Also need an intl review for formatting/locales.

jamal: dependency note: infra team still finalizing the new quota headers — ETA Tue EOD. if that lands late we should shift review by 24h.

alex: OK — propose two tentative slots (pick one):
- Wed Mar 18 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET
- Thu Mar 19 3:00pm PT / 6:00pm ET
Please RSVP with :1: or :2: and call out any absolute blockers.

maria: :1: works for me. will finish pre-read comments by Tue EOD.

kevin: :1: for SDK walkthru.

lina: :2: preferred but can move if security absolutely needed in slot 1. need 30m to cover threat model.

alex: Here's the pre-read checklist (short):
```
[ ] API contract doc (alex) — link in pre-read
[ ] SDK sample flows + auth matrix (kevin)
[ ] Console mockups + clickthrough (maria)
[ ] Threat model + PII mapping (lina)
[ ] Rollout/canary plan + fallback (alex/jamal)
[ ] Migration notes & deprecation window (docs)
```
If an owner is missing, shout now.

jamal: I can take the rollout/canary section with alex. will stub the canary playbook by Tue.

calendar-bot: Created tentative event "Configurable Routing - Design Handoff" for 2026-03-18 10:00 PT (pending RSVPs).

maria: tiny ask — can we add an explicit code snippet in the pre-read that shows header examples for quota/versioning? that helps QA.

alex: will add that today. also adding a short migration checklist for customers.

lina: if slot 1 stays, schedule 30 extra minutes for security breakout immediately after (optional).

alex: noted. final ask: reviewers, please leave pre-read comments inline by Tue 6pm PT so we can ship the final deck Wed morning. otherwise we'll move to Thu. :thumbsup:

kevin: ack — will do inline comments.

maria: ack.

jamal: ack, will finish playbook stub.

lina: will post threat model notes by Tue noon.

alex: thanks all — will update pre-read + send final calendar invite after Tue 6pm cutoff. if infra lands the headers earlier we'll keep slot 1; otherwise shift to slot 2.

alex: tagging @here — last call for other reviewers (docs, intl, support).

support: (automated) noted; will triage any migration-question threads after the meeting.
